BiblicalUsage: Chaciyd means kind, godly, a saint — the merciful one. Moses calls Levi God's holy one, Hannah sings that He will keep the feet of His saints, David sings that with the merciful God shows Himself merciful, and Solomon prays that God's saints will rejoice in goodness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a saint in the Old Testament is not a perfect person but a kind one — one God has been kind to, and who shows it back. Kindness is the mark of the godly, and God keeps the feet of the kind.
